glyph_origin: Phono-semantic compound (形聲): semantic 言 (“say”) + phonetic 戠.
s_page_origin: Simplified from 識 (言 → 讠 and 戠 → 只). / Simplified from 䛊 (言 → 讠).
senses: to know; to realise; to be aware
(Cantonese, Hakka, dialectal Wu) to recognise; to be familiar with; …
[zhì] (obsolete in standard Chinese) to put a mark
note: glyph_origin is from the traditional page 識; s_page_origin explains the simplified 识.
